split: first 8 vs remaining 12 in source-only frozen manifest order
shortcut_grammar: DIRECT: after first verifier PASS, permit ACTIVE when acquisition gain >= learned direct threshold
BORDERLINE: after first two verifier PASSes, permit ACTIVE when acquisition gain >= learned borderline threshold
threshold_learning: lowest development-set gain threshold giving at least one shortcut and zero false promotions after full development deployment; otherwise disabled
heldout_pass_gate: >=10% fewer verifier checks than V12, deployment verified events >= V12, failures <= V12, survival precision >= V12
